sources.title: Invest Dominica Authority, Work and Residency Permit
sources.said: Non Nationals wishing to engage in work in Dominica must first obtain a work permit from the Labour Division. … All work permits are valid for one-year duration and can be renewed. … Letter from employer stating the following: type of employment, wages (daily, weekly, monthly); accepting responsibility for employee; and offer of employment for one year in the first instance … Application fee: EC$800.00 US$295.00 (Non-CARICOM Members) OR EC$250.00 US$93.00 (CARCOM) … Three copies of newspaper clippings of advertised vacant position

note: Invest Dominica (the government's investment authority) gives the Labour Division's requirements: form L.I. 12 with an employer's letter offering employment for a year in the first instance, three newspaper clippings of the advertised vacancy, and an application fee of EC$800 for a non-CARICOM national (EC$250 for a CARICOM national). No performer's category, union step, minimum pay or exempt days are named. The Employment of Non-Nationals Act itself wasn't read.
